repository.name: @webex/plugin-people
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.people that reads Webex person records from the Webex REST API (catalog service hydra). get(person) takes a uuid, a hydra person id, a person object, or the string me; me is fetched from people/me with concurrent calls sharing one request, and every other id goes through a batcher that turns concurrent lookups into one GET people/?id=...&showAllTypes=... of up to 10 ids per flush (100 ms quiet, 1500 ms at most). Ids are normalized locally: a uuid becomes the base64url hydra id ciscospark://us/PEOPLE/uuid without a request, so a uuid and its hydra id share one lookup. list(options) resolves an array of persons for an array of ids through the same batcher, or a Page of results for a query object such as email or displayName. Nothing is cached or persisted.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-people package entry
public_interfaces.audience: SDK bundles (webex, webex-node, recipe-private-web-client) and applications that build their own webex instance
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package registers People as public plugin 'people' with the people config; the first registration of the name wins. The default export People is the only export; config is not exported.

public_interfaces.name: webex.people methods
public_interfaces.audience: applications and SDK packages (@webex/common event envelopes, @webex/plugin-meetings meeting info, @webex/calling caller-id lookup)
public_interfaces.notes: get rejects a falsy person with 'A person with an id is required'; get('me') requests people/me directly; any other value is reduced to personId, then id, then the value itself, and looked up through the batcher. list with an array resolves a plain array of persons in input order (not a Page); list with an object sends it as the query string of GET people and resolves a webex-core Page. inferPersonIdFromUuid is marked @private in its JSDoc but is called by the batcher and by the integration spec. A not-found id rejects with the id string, not an Error.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.notes: build runs build:src, which writes dist. test:unit runs the jest unit specs, which import the package by name and so test dist; run build:src first. test:browser:broken (commands.browser-test) runs karma over test/integration/spec but bundles nothing today (0 tests, exit 0). The aggregate test script runs test:style and test:unit, then exits 1 because test:integration is not defined (and it names test:browser, which is not defined either); it is deliberately not a manifest command.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not call webex.request for people/?id= outside the batcher.
negative_guidance.why: Lookups by id must be de-duplicated and grouped so a burst sends one request per flush (INV-001).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change the fingerprint functions without keeping a uuid and its hydra id on the same key.
negative_guidance.why: Responses carry hydra ids; a request keyed by anything else never settles (INV-002).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change the cluster in inferPersonIdFromUuid.
negative_guidance.why: Hydra ids for PEOPLE always use cluster us (common MOD-006); other ids would not match responses.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log person ids, emails, or display names.
negative_guidance.why: They identify users; the package logs nothing today.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the behavior reference.
negative_guidance.why: It shows only get(id); see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: No coverage script or threshold exists.
